# Discount codes and gift cards

New customers get 10% off their first order after signing up for our newsletter. The code arrives by email and is valid for 30 days.
Only one discount code can be used per order. Codes cannot be combined and do not apply to sale items or gift cards.
Gift cards are valid for 3 years from the purchase date and can be used for any product. They are sent by email and cannot be exchanged for cash.
If a code does not work, check the expiry date and that your cart contains no excluded items.
